business_problem: Grab needed a more accurate and efficient way to map fast-changing Southeast Asian road networks, where manual intervention and conventional mapping coverage were insufficient for local traffic rules and complex geometries.
solution_summary: Grab uses GPT-4o vision fine-tuning inside GrabMaps to automate detailed mapmaking from street-level imagery gathered across Southeast Asia. The company collects millions of 360-degree images through motorbike drivers and pedestrian partners, then combines that imagery with map tiles to train models that can localize speed-limit signs, turn restrictions, road geometries, lane dividers, and other hyperlocal features. An initial speed-limit-sign workflow improved from 67% to 80% accuracy after only two rounds of fine-tuning on 100 sample cases, and the same approach helped the model reason through elevated roads, occlusions, and context that had previously required manual correction. The resulting location-intelligence data supports Grab’s ride-hailing and delivery operations and is also packaged for enterprise customers, while related AI work is expanding into accessibility and support assistants for broader platform use.

solution_components.name: GrabMaps
solution_components.role: Transforms street-level imagery into localized mapping and location-intelligence data for Grab’s operations and enterprise customers.

solution_components.name: GPT-4o
solution_components.role: Provides the vision fine-tuning and contextual reasoning used to detect road features and map complex geometries.

data_flow: Street-level imagery from drivers and pedestrian partners is combined with map tiles and sent through GPT-4o fine-tuned vision workflows. The resulting sign, lane, and road-geometry annotations feed GrabMaps, which then supports internal mobility services and external enterprise location-intelligence offerings.
business_outcome: Grab improved lane and sign localization accuracy, reduced manual mapping work and operational costs, and created a more trustworthy, hyperlocal map platform that better serves users, driver-partners, and enterprise customers.
